data_policy: No fitting, threshold change, instruction replacement, seed replacement, or performance-based retries. Reject duplicate initial layouts against all original demonstrations, consumed v2, development controls, v3 acceptance and this run. All unsupported requests are predeclared language-only challenges; an erroneous accept fails the gate.
scope: One LIBERO Object tomato-to-basket task; synchronous Agent integration, no async timing or physical robot acceptance. Language is finite English. Unsupported labels remain evaluator-only.
